title: 791 Releases. 48% Unchecked.
caption:
I have never once opened a browser to check what my agents shipped.

Panche Isajeski published the audit of running his one-person payments company on nine AI agents: 114 days, 1,033 active hours, 3,313 agent runs, 791 releases. 161 of them in a single week. 48% with no browser check after. Only 6% of his sessions started with a plan, and 59% of his code edits came from the agents.

What stopped me is which gate he bothered to enforce. Sending, publishing, paying, deploying and deleting are blocked or ask him first — 109 emails drafted in that window and he sent every one by hand. His customers' inbox was protected. His own codebase wasn't. He runs the whole thing for about $320 a month, and estimates the same nine roles as part-time freelancers at ~$15k. Every figure here is his own count of his own work.

Browser check goes in tonight. What do you check before shipping?
